description: Procurement profile of a French public buyer (by SIRET): contract volumes by year, top CPV segments, incumbent suppliers with their contracts expiring within 18 months, framework-agreement share, share of amounts that are envelopes rather than firm prices, share of contracts with declared subcontracting, share granting an advance, dominant CCAG and price type, publishing platform, average bids received per tender and median publication delay: the buying habits to know before a sourcing meeting. From official DECP open data. Paid via x402 ($0.02 in USDC or EURC). Names are served for legal persons proven by their Sirene legal category only: a sole proprietorship, a group of natural persons or a category in doubt never has its name served and keeps its SIREN or SIRET, the omissions counted without identity in ecartes, over the entries the response serves (rule R1). A contract subject that names a person by a civility followed by a capital letter (M., Mme, Monsieur, Madame, Maître…) is served null, counted without identity in ecartes; the contract stays (rule R1). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

siret.description: 14-digit SIRET of the public buyer, e.g. 26310012500016 (CHU de Toulouse)

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.

name: get_french_public_buyer_profile

free_tier.description: Free API key offer, with a quote.

payment_required.description: True for an x402 payment quote instead of data.

resultat.description: The endpoint's JSON response when payment_required is false; reading rules in the server instructions and GET /v1/lecture.
